name: Fuyu Persimmons by Baumer
tagline: Gilcrest and Levy counties, North Florida Persimmon U
description: A working apple orchard in 671 NW 165 St, FL, Fuyu Persimmons by Baumer grows Blueberries, Apples, Corn, Honey, and Eggs. The orchard is busiest in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
